messages.subject: For Ignacio Madridejos | Infrastructure, sustainability and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Ferrovial Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ignacio Madridejos, Chief Executive Officer, and the sustainability leadership team.

Ferrovial's airports, highways, construction and energy activities require disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex regulated environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement, coordinate complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability, stakeholder strategy and infrastructure-adjacent operating experience might support Ferrovial's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Ferrovial.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
